parameters.query:
with payload as (
  -- aceita tanto um array de veículos quanto um único objeto
  select case jsonb_typeof($1::jsonb)
           when 'array'  then $1::jsonb
           when 'object' then jsonb_build_array($1::jsonb)
           else '[]'::jsonb
         end as body
),
rows as (
  select
    v->>'identifier'                               as identifier,
    v->>'unit_id'                                  as unit_id,
    v->>'name'                                     as name,
    v->>'brand'                                    as brand,
    v->>'model'                                    as model,
    v->>'version'                                  as version,
    nullif(v->>'model_year','')::int               as model_year,
    nullif(v->>'fabrication_year','')::int         as fabrication_year,
    nullif(v->>'km','')::int                       as km,
    nullif(replace(v->>'price',',','.'),'')::numeric(12,2) as price,
    v->>'exchange'                                 as exchange,
    v->>'fuel_text'                                as fuel_text,
    v->>'color'                                    as color,
    nullif(v->>'doors','')::int                    as doors,
    v->>'kind'                                     as kind,
    v->>'note'                                     as note,
    -- arrays sempre presentes (evita erro quando vier null)
    (select coalesce(array_agg(x::text), '{}')
       from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(v->'item_list','[]'::jsonb)) x) as item_list,
    coalesce(v->'pictures_attributes','[]'::jsonb) as pictures,
    v->>'remote_profile_image_url'                 as main_image,
    v->>'store'                                    as store,
    v->>'plate'                                    as plate,
    v->>'category'                                 as category,
    coalesce((v->>'sold')::int,0)        = 1       as sold,
    coalesce((v->>'in_transit')::int,0)  = 1       as in_transit,
    coalesce((v->>'new_vehicle')::int,0) = 1       as new_vehicle,
    coalesce((v->>'featured')::int,0)    = 1       as featured,
    coalesce((v->>'shielded')::int,0)    = 1       as shielded,

    -- *** SANITIZAÇÃO DE DATA ***
    case
      when coalesce(v->>'synced_at','') = '' then null
      when v->>'synced_at' = '0000-00-00 00:00:00' then null
      when (v->>'synced_at') ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}$'
        then (v->>'synced_at')::timestamp
      else null
    end::timestamptz                               as synced_at,

    v                                              as raw
  from payload, jsonb_array_elements(payload.body) v
),
ins as (
  insert into vehicles as t (
    identifier, unit_id, name, brand, model, version, model_year, fabrication_year, km, price,
    exchange, fuel_text, color, doors, kind, note, item_list, pictures, main_image, store,
    plate, category, sold, in_transit, new_vehicle, featured, shielded, synced_at, batch_id, active, raw
  )
  select
    r.identifier, r.unit_id, r.name, r.brand, r.model, r.version, r.model_year, r.fabrication_year, r.km, r.price,
    r.exchange, r.fuel_text, r.color, r.doors, r.kind, r.note, r.item_list, r.pictures, r.main_image, r.store,
    r.plate, r.category, r.sold, r.in_transit, r.new_vehicle, r.featured, r.shielded, r.synced_at,
    now(), true, r.raw
  from rows r
  on conflict (identifier) do update
  set unit_id          = excluded.unit_id,
      name             = excluded.name,
      brand            = excluded.brand,
      model            = excluded.model,
      version          = excluded.version,
      model_year       = excluded.model_year,
      fabrication_year = excluded.fabrication_year,
      km               = excluded.km,
      price            = excluded.price,
      exchange         = excluded.exchange,
      fuel_text        = excluded.fuel_text,
      color            = excluded.color,
      doors            = excluded.doors,
      kind             = excluded.kind,
      note             = excluded.note,
      item_list        = excluded.item_list,
      pictures         = excluded.pictures,
      main_image       = excluded.main_image,
      store            = excluded.store,
      plate            = excluded.plate,
      category         = excluded.category,
      sold             = excluded.sold,
      in_transit       = excluded.in_transit,
      new_vehicle      = excluded.new_vehicle,
      featured         = excluded.featured,
      shielded         = excluded.shielded,
      synced_at        = excluded.synced_at,
      batch_id         = excluded.batch_id,
      active           = true,
      raw              = excluded.raw
  returning 1
),
soft as (
  update vehicles t
  set active = false
  where t.active = true
    and t.batch_id < (select max(batch_id) from vehicles)
    and not exists (select 1 from rows r where r.identifier = t.identifier)
  returning 1
)
select
  (select count(*) from rows) as input_rows,
  (select count(*) from ins)  as upserts,
  (select count(*) from soft) as deactivated;
